timing.text: In the west, the Tibetan Plateau rises above four thousand meters.
From the seventh century, the Sui Dynasty organized the Grand Canal as an imperial transport system.
By the thirteenth century, its network linked five major river basins carrying grain and helping supply the population and troops.
After the Han collapsed, centuries of political division followed, before the Sui reunified the Empire in five eighty-nine.
